name: Workspaces with Desktop Mode
author: Fred (@greenermoose)
description: Workspace numbers with clickable desktop modes and dynamic all-monitor Windows sets

schema.label: Allow a window focus to split the set (Windows mode)
schema.description: Windows mode only. When a window focus lands on a hidden workspace, Hyprland moves just that monitor. true: the set splits — that monitor shows a hollow marker and an F mode letter until clicked back or the set is moved by a bar click or SUPER+number. false: the whole set follows to the focused monitor's desktop.
